text:
```yaml
name: Update uv.lock

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
      - develop
    paths:
      - 'pyproject.toml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'pyproject.toml'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  update-uv-lock:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'Update uv.lock')"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          version: "latest"

      - name: Update uv.lock
        run: uv lock

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet uv.lock; then
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.changed == 'true' && github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          author_name: "GitHub Actions"
          author_email: "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          message: "Update uv.lock"
          add: "uv.lock"
          push: true

      - name: Fail if lockfile out of sync on PR
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.changed == 'true' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "::error::uv.lock is out of sync with pyproject.toml. Please run 'uv lock' and commit the changes."
          exit 1
```
